coreRuntimeProblem.zh-Hans: 巨大空间、多样人口与边疆如何在同一政治 Runtime 中长期协调。
coreRuntimeProblem.en: How large territories, diverse populations, and frontiers are coordinated within one political runtime.

description.zh-Hans: 中央与地方如何分配治理、记录与执行。
description.en: How central and local governance, records, and execution are organized.

description.zh-Hans: 大型政治体如何处理边境、缓冲区与不同人口。
description.en: How large polities handle frontiers, buffers, and diverse populations.

description.zh-Hans: 秩序如何被解释、接受与延续。
description.en: How political order is explained, accepted, and carried forward.

description.zh-Hans: 道路、水利、城市与运输如何支撑尺度。
description.en: How roads, hydraulics, cities, and transport support scale.

coreRuntimeProblem.zh-Hans: 共同文明如何在没有单一长期政治中心时维持连接与差异。
coreRuntimeProblem.en: How a civilization sustains connection and diversity without one durable political center.

description.zh-Hans: 政治、城市与知识中心是否集中于单一点。
description.en: Whether political, urban, and knowledge centers are concentrated in one node.

description.zh-Hans: 多个节点之间如何交换资源、规则与文化。
description.en: How multiple nodes exchange resources, norms, and culture.

description.zh-Hans: 在政治分散条件下如何保持共同文明辨识。
description.en: How shared civilizational identity persists under political dispersion.

coreRuntimeProblem.zh-Hans: 港口、航线与海上网络如何把影响半径扩展到领土之外。
coreRuntimeProblem.en: How ports, sea lanes, and maritime networks extend reach beyond territory.

description.zh-Hans: 港口如何组织贸易、人口与信息流。
description.en: How ports organize trade, population, and information flows.

description.zh-Hans: 航线如何改变文明影响半径与依赖。
description.en: How sea lanes change civilizational reach and dependency.

description.zh-Hans: 商人、船队、公司与港市如何承载扩展。
description.en: How merchants, fleets, companies, and port cities carry expansion.

coreRuntimeProblem.zh-Hans: 知识如何被保存、复制、传播并跨越原有政治载体。
coreRuntimeProblem.en: How knowledge is preserved, replicated, transmitted, and carried beyond its original political carrier.

description.zh-Hans: 文字、档案、经典与其他媒介如何保存知识。
description.en: How writing, archives, canons, and other media preserve knowledge.

description.zh-Hans: 知识副本如何增加并进入更多节点。
description.en: How knowledge copies increase and reach more nodes.

description.zh-Hans: 谁能够学习、生产和重新解释知识。
description.en: Who can learn, produce, and reinterpret knowledge.

description.zh-Hans: 知识如何脱离原政治边界继续传播。
description.en: How knowledge continues beyond original political borders.

coreRuntimeProblem.zh-Hans: 贸易、市场与连接如何在不依赖统一领土控制的情况下扩大文明 Reality。
coreRuntimeProblem.en: How trade, markets, and connectivity expand civilizational reality without unified territorial control.

description.zh-Hans: 交换活动在城市、区域与跨区域尺度上的密集程度。
description.en: Density of exchange across cities, regions, and long-distance networks.

description.zh-Hans: 商业关系能够跨越多远以及连接多少节点。
description.en: How far commercial relationships reach and how many nodes they connect.

description.zh-Hans: 支付、货币与信用如何降低远距离交易摩擦。
description.en: How payment, money, and credit reduce friction in distant exchange.

description.zh-Hans: 高连接如何同时形成新的外部依赖。
description.en: How high connectivity also creates external dependencies.

coreRuntimeProblem.zh-Hans: 高密度能源、机器、现代制度与全球网络如何共同改变文明尺度。
coreRuntimeProblem.en: How dense energy, machines, modern institutions, and global networks jointly transform civilizational scale.

description.zh-Hans: 可调用能源如何改变生产、运输与城市规模。
description.en: How available energy changes production, transport, and urban scale.

description.zh-Hans: 机器化生产与标准化复制如何扩展物质能力。
description.en: How mechanized production and standardized replication expand material capacity.

description.zh-Hans: 通信速度如何压缩协调距离。
description.en: How communications compress coordination distance.

description.zh-Hans: 工业扩张如何嵌入更大的全球资源与市场网络。
description.en: How industrial expansion embeds societies in larger global resource and market networks.
